combination: The Phase 5 metadata component preserves its 0.7 genre/0.3 tag Jaccard formula when both fields are present and renormalizes over pairwise-present fields when one is missing. Per-component scores become within-query percentile ranks; configured weights combine available ranks; final rank score is multiplied by available/query-signal weight coverage. Candidates require at least two positive component similarities.
evaluation_note: Qualitative diagnostic only; no held-out rating evaluation or weight tuning.
